content:
Rita (Data): Heads up — finalizing the golden prompt set for the q4-model bring-up. Need a quick cross-check on dedupe heuristics and a labeling handoff. Plan: fuzzy dedupe -> sample ~2k borderline pairs -> labelers review -> assemble final 256 golden. Can folks confirm labeling capacity and flag any edge-case categories to include?

Alex (ML Eng): I can take the final review and run canary evals. +1 on including prompt-level sensitivity tags (length, code, math). :thumbsup:

Toni (Model Ops): Do we have the dedupe command/threshold we settled on? Also need the S3 paths so I can provision the labeling job.

Rita (Data): Dedupe cmd i'm running is: `python scripts/dedupe.py --in s3://redwood-datasets/prompt-collection/combined_v3.jsonl --threshold 0.87 --method fuzzy --out s3://redwood-datasets/golden/curation_batch_2026.jsonl`
Include these columns in the output: `id, text, lang, length, contains_code, sensitivity:quant, dedupe_score`.

Sam (Evals): Request: please tag any prompts that historically triggered hallucination/regression in 8-bit quant runs. We should reserve ~50 of those in the golden to watch regressions.

Rita (Data): Good call. I pulled an audit of past failures and will add `sensitivity:quant` values (low/med/high). Also adding an explicit `edge_case` flag for examples with multi-step math or long context.

labels-bot: Queue created: `curation_batch_2026`. 8 labelers assigned, estimated throughput 500/hr, ETA ~48h. Queue link: https://labels.redwood.ai/queue/curation_batch_2026 :robot_face:

Toni (Model Ops): For the labeling job, I'll attach this config to the task: `instructions_v2.md` + examples for ambiguous dedupe pairs. Also enabling a quick-review step where each borderline pair gets 2 independent labels.

Alex (ML Eng): Quick note on sampling: ensure stratified sample by `length` and `contains_code` so golden isn't biased to short chatty prompts. Also include ~30 few-shot code generation prompts. :eyes:

Rita (Data): Done — sampling script updated. Path to spreadsheet for manual review: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xCurate/golden_review (please add comments rather than editing rows).

Sam (Evals): Can we schedule a small eval run as soon as labeling finishes? I want to run the labeled golden against `redwood-v2-2026-q8` and `redwood-v2-2026-ptq` for quick regression signals.

eval-bot: Scheduled eval: `golden_smoke_2026-03` on models [`redwood-v2-2026-q8`, `redwood-v2-2026-ptq`] at 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z. Report will be posted to #eng-ml.

Rita (Data): Who can own the final pass (merge labeled labels -> final jsonl)? Need one owner to avoid conflicts.

Alex (ML Eng): I'll own the merge and kick off the canary evals once labeling is marked complete. Will post results in thread.

Rita (Data): Amazing — thanks everyone. Timeline: dedupe run now, labeling queued, final golden + merge by EOD Friday if queue stays healthy. Ping me if you see bad clusters or repeated paraphrases I missed. :pray:
